usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the RPN calculator in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj build` and gives the expected output on a test run through `wj run --compiled`.

I ran both examples from the task plus two extra lines. All six example lines printed the expected output. `-7 2 /` gave `-3` (truncation toward zero), and a lone `-` gave `error: underflow`. A blank line in the input was skipped.

I didn't test very large
